title: Native Design Bias: Studying the Impact of English Nativeness on Language Model Performance

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance (accuracy for classification tasks; fluency, coherence, and relevance for generative tasks) when prompted by Western native, non-Western native, and non-native English speakers using a newly collected dataset of over 12,000 human-written prompts.

Measuring changes in model accuracy and behavior when explicitly prepending correct or incorrect information about the prompt writer's nativeness (e.g., 'Respond as if you are interacting with a non-native English speaker') to the system instructions.
